sql_a: SELECT CUS_NUM, SUM(CASE WHEN TRA_DATE >= SYSDATE - :cs_b1 AND TRA_DATE < SYSDATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS RECENT_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN TRA_DATE >= SYSDATE - :cs_b2 AND TRA_DATE < SYSDATE - :cs_b3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PRIOR_COUNT FROM BI_DWH.PIO_TRANSACTIONS GROUP BY CUS_NUM
